Our goal is to reduce our direct greenhouse gas emissions by 10% on a per unit basis by 2020 
from 2010 levels. In 2014, The U.S. EPA introduced new global warming potentials (GWPs) for 
many fluorinated liquids that previously had no GWPs. As a result, our “Other Greenhouse Gases” 
emissions increased significantly in 2014 from 2013.
